entries.before: Sixth narrower P2CG1 successor: both HTTP doors keyed on the installed registry port, plus transport hardening. The campaignLaunchAuthorityRoute handler becomes async. When the port is installed and the body carries sessionId, it prepares the P2CB view in its own graph (createDurableCampaignLaunchView; a foreign-graph handle is never adopted) outside the existing read transaction and revalidates it inside, keeping branch, saga and replacement refusal precedence. Otherwise it keeps the legacy cursor gate, which is today's behaviour, including the head-only answer for session-less bodies. campaignLaunchProgressionGate exposes both branches. createCoopMissionMatch selects the P2CG1C prepared operation when the port is installed, else the old create. campaignSyncTransport changes, effective only in receipt mode: CF7 option (a), which ignores campaign-application-unknown-receipt when a newer offer was registered since the refused ACK (latest !== sent) and otherwise rejoins; CF8 bounds, a capped number of head-drift re-sends and a bounded wait for a lost refusal, then recovery-required so the consumer rejoins (the client answer to the P2CE3 write-unchecked refusal frames); CF12, the socket close surfaced as a recovery-required signal; and an expectedCampaignId-bound join keeps quoting lastSeq (the server ignores it in receipt mode, so the client-claimed cursor never selects the cut). P2CF1 m2/m3 may be registered as cases while the transport leaf is open. Numeric-ACK retirement is not part of this unit.
